title: Count Elements With Strictly Smaller and Greater Elements
goal: Count elements having both a strictly smaller and a strictly larger value somewhere in the array.
strategy: An element qualifies exactly when it lies strictly between the global minimum and maximum. Equal copies of either extreme remain excluded.
